description: Na₃LaTi₂Nb₂O₁₂ is Orthorhombic Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.58-2.69 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.42 Å) and two longer (2.45 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.88 Å. La is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.89 Å. There are two inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-26°. There are two shorter (1.97 Å) and four longer (1.98 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-24°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-1.99 Å. There are two inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-26°. There are four shorter (2.01 Å) and two longer (2.02 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-24°. There are two shorter (2.00 Å) and four longer (2.02 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, one Ti, and one Nb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, one Ti, and one Nb atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, one Ti, and one Nb atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one La, one Ti, and one Nb atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ti, and one Nb atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, one Ti, and one Nb atom.
